# Optionality

> An AI-judged options trading practice drill. The Firm deals an options
> trading scenario; the trainee writes a free-text trade pitch; an AI judge
> scores it across six dimensions, parses the trade legs, and shows how well
> the pitch separated signal from noise. Identity is a Nostr keypair (npub);
> usage is metered in Bitcoin Lightning satoshis — no account, no email, no
> subscription, no KYC.

Optionality is a single-page web app backed by an MCP (Model Context
Protocol) server. Humans use the web UI; AI agents can call the same MCP
tools directly. This is a training simulator — nothing here is investment
advice and no real orders are placed.

## What is on this site

- **The Pit** — deal a scenario. Three historicity modes (historical,
  fiction, live — live grounds the scenario in today's market via web
  search) crossed with four difficulty personas (apprentice, journeyman,
  adept, sovereign). Optional sector hint and max-loss budget.
- **Pitch editor** — write a free-text trade proposal against the dealt
  scenario. A Socratic clue desk answers questions without spoiling.
- **Assessment** — the judge evaluates structure, strikes & tenor,
  risk/reward, macro context, and tail awareness; parses the pitch into
  structured legs; and emits a Facts Ledger. Every scenario embeds red
  herrings — facts that are true but immaterial; citing them as trade
  drivers costs points, dismissing them earns points.
- **Journal** — every play persists; any evaluated entry can be replayed as
  a mulligan.
- **Leaderboard** — global peer rankings by weighted average, best score,
  streak, and plays.
- **Profile & Usage** — display name, avatar, Nostr relays, peer DMs, and a
  transparency view of Claude API token spend per model.

## Payments and identity

- Sign in with a Nostr npub; prove ownership via a Nostr DM challenge
  (`request_npub_proof` / `receive_npub_proof`).
- Pre-fund a satoshi balance with a Bitcoin Lightning invoice
  (`purchase_credits`); tool calls debit it. `check_price` previews any
  tool's cost before committing.
- Monetization is the Tollbooth DPYC protocol (https://tollbooth-dpyc.com):
  operator-controlled dynamic per-tool pricing at the MCP layer.

## For AI agents

- MCP endpoint: https://optionality-mcp.fastmcp.app/mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Start with `optionality_service_status` (free, no arguments) to check
  liveness, then `optionality_check_price` to preview costs.
- The slow LLM tools (`deal_scenario`, `ask_tip`, `judge_trade`) return a
  claim check rather than the end item; redeem it with the free companion
  tools (`fetch_scenario`, `fetch_tip`, `fetch_judgement`), polling until
  `status` is `done`.
- Reads like `get_leaderboard`, `list_journal`, and `get_shared_entries`
  are inexpensive or free.
